product_metadata.title: Hofomca Christmas Throw Pillow Covers 18x18 Set of 4, Merry Christmas Tree Gnome Red Truck Candy Cane Xmas Farmhouse Decorations Rustic Winter Holiday Couch Cover for Sofa Bedroom Home Outdoor
features: 【High-Quality Material】:Breathable linen fabric and handmade make it comfortable, durable, beautiful, designed in feature Christmas tree, gnomes, car and cookies, more energy and fun to your Christmas.

【Hidden Zipper】:Hidden zipper closure makes the appearance more elegant and easy to cram your pillow/filler into this cover. The hidden zipper design of the holiday pillow covers makes the whole pillow more beautiful.

【Standard Size】:Set of 4 throw pillow covers 18x18 inches/ 45cm x 45cm，does not include inserts or stuffing. Pattern is only on the front and no printing on the back. Modern simple farmhouse style decorative red Christmas pillow cases makes the gifts perfect, also nice gift choice for your friends.

【Machine Washable】: The Christmas tree gnome red truck throw pillows for couch can be used for a long time and can be removed for cleaning in washing machine. We suggest hand wash or machine wash in cold water separately, gently cycle only, dot not bleach, tumble dry low, do not iron.

【Applicable Occasions】: To decorative your room in christmas style way, enjoy a new christmas which you never had before, new decoration means new experience. Suitable for couch, sofa, bed, car, seat, window seat, loveseat, living room, bed room, floor, bench, matches well with your furniture and bedding sets.
